ordering: The reconciled full-source component hash order; retain whole known components, including blocked jobs. The first completed 128-observation pilot is reused, including its one transfer failure, not resampled.
retention: Keep all 27 raw endpoint slots, 5 bbox conditions for the five bbox-sensitive endpoints, source and oriented-pixel hashes, detector geometry, paired floral/non-head/green-context statistics, and every blocked/download/no-detection/QC outcome. Source images are temporary memory inputs only.
resume: Each photo is a numerical transaction inside a component-preserving chunk. Reuse only integrity-verified unit outputs bound to the same packet and algorithm. Persist completed units when a chunk is interrupted; restore those units before requesting remaining photos. Do not retry a recorded terminal transfer failure without a separate policy revision. A verified completed chunk is downloaded and checked, not rerun.
scope_revision: The verified source replay and completed all27 pilot permit bounded raw acquisition. This does not admit a changed colour recipe, resolve the 13 technical holds, authorize any trait-environment join, or claim full-cohort completion. Raw acquisition may precede those inference qualifications because all candidate values and QC states remain saved.
